note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (jurisdiction unspecified). The two scenes are identical except which supplied conduct runs (lane A in A, lane B in B), drawn at equal size, colour and timing. No winner, share, percentage, fault, contributory-negligence doctrine, liability, amount or outcome is stated.
